description: Stop sharing one mailbox with a member. Their credentials that reached only through that mailbox are revoked. Removing a mailbox that is not shared changes nothing. Needs the members:write permission, which is opt-in and never part of a default. It acts with the authority of the person who approved this connection or created the API key.
name: shipmail_revoke_member_mailbox_access

mailbox_ids.description: Mailbox IDs visible to this API credential. Empty when scope is "all"; for "selected", the list can be partial when the credential reaches only some granted mailboxes.

title: Unshare Mailbox From Member
